question: What fruits are obtained by performing Durga worship on Mahanavami and Kartika full moon?
premises: Durga worship on Mahanavami and Kartika full moon yields fruit.
Seen and unseen desired fruits become easily obtained.
inference: Therefore the rite grants every desired seen and unseen fruit without difficulty.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalaṃ is not fully certain.
plain_english: All desired fruits, seen and unseen, become easily obtained.
